capability: Score every answer; send only above a bar
title: Send only what clears the gate.

hook.picture: Close on two finished lines that look the same; the whale pushes one to a pod, which answers ✕ (copper chip).
hook.words: It looked fine when I sent it.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Is this answer good enough? Honestly, I can't tell.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer about to paste an AI answer into a ticket

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three lines sent by eye, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; the third pod answers ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nothing measures it before it goes out.

stakes.body: Wrong answers shipped on gut feel, then found by a customer or a reviewer.

solution_hint: Score every answer. Send only above the bar.

metaphor.body: A gate on the line with a mark on its lintel; a ring scores each line as it arrives; below the mark it goes back for another pass.

steps.picture: A gate rises on the line with a mark on its lintel; a ring pulses round each arriving line and a counter shows its reading.
Push-in: a line rings low; the gate stays shut; the line goes back, the whale reworks it, it returns and rings higher.
steps.words: Too low? Back for another pass.

steps.picture: The line clears the mark; the gate opens; a pod answers ✓.
The gate mark glows; the counter holds its passing reading.

real_case.claim: The categorical-meta-prompting README scores every output 0 to 1 and refines to a threshold; its example run climbs 0.65, 0.78, 0.91 (an illustration in the README).

honest_limit.picture: A smooth line of the wrong colour rings high and slides through the gate; a pod downstream answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: A confident wrong answer can score high.

not_this.body: A high score is not a true answer.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot of the two look-alike lines; now each wears its ring score. One sits under the mark, one above. The whale sends only the one above; pod ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT two lines looked identical and the wrong one shipped; the same shot now shows them different, and the right one goes.

end_belief.body: Set a bar. Score it. Then send.
